metadataRaw.title: Standing Sciatica Release (RELIEF IN SECONDS!)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a standing sciatic nerve release (also known as nerve flossing) that may provide sciatica pain relief in just 30 seconds.

It works by reducing pressure and tension along the sciatic nerve as it travels from the lower back into the leg. Use it at home or at work whenever a flare-up strikes and you need quick relief.

Let us know how it works for you!
